doctrine.d: A site that looks like everyone else's performs like everyone else's. We start from zero, every time.
Speed, motion, weight — tuned until a visitor can't look away. Attention is the only currency that converts.
Pretty is the floor. Everything we build is aimed at a number: revenue, leads, dominance.
Your competitors are the benchmark. We build the thing that makes their site feel like a relic.

problems.problem: Sell you a template, call it custom, then outsource the build.
problems.solution: Every project starts from a blank file — the same two people scope it, build it and ship it.

problems.problem: Disappear the day the invoice clears.
problems.solution: We're still around for the redesign, the new feature, the thing that breaks two years from now.

problems.problem: Sell you a strategy deck, then outsource the actual build.
problems.solution: We build what we pitch — no hand-off to a dev shop you've never met.

problems.problem: Ship clean code with no opinion on whether it makes you money.
problems.solution: Every build decision gets weighed against one question: does this convert.

boldStatements: If your website doesn't generate leads, it's a liability.
Two people build this. Not fifteen you'll never meet.
Templates are for brands that have given up.
Growth is engineered. Not wished for.

About.intro: 404 DAMNED isn't a faceless agency with a rotating cast of account managers. It's two people — Nick and Stathis — who work on your project directly, with Tatiana joining soon as the third. No hand-offs, no anonymous "team".
About.storyHeading: The name is newer than the work
About.storyBody: 404 DAMNED as a studio is the result of experience that goes back to 2017 — years of freelance work and time inside other companies and agencies, long before this name existed. Nick brought company and project management, Stathis brought web development and e-commerce. At some point the two of us realised we were better off building under one name than separately, so we did. Tatiana, who brings web development and digital marketing, is joining as the third.
